seriesTitle: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston

episodes.title: Tremors
episodes.summary: As tremors begin, Tom asks: Will anyone recognize the danger? He traces two Romans ignoring the warning signs of disaster.

episodes.title: Eruption
episodes.summary: As ash falls, Tom asks: Who will escape, and who will act? He follows a soldier, a mother and a boy as survival hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Survival
episodes.summary: As the final surge hits, Tom asks: Who survives, and at what cost? New evidence reveals the fate of three real Romans.
